scope: Stage A one-bounce diffuse, matched primary surfaces, environment off, averaged material policy
notes: Engineering acceptance limits, frozen before this suite's first GPU capture; never calibrated to its results.
40% fixture NRMSE at 64 is a declared coarse-voxel allowance, above the previously documented 22.89% panel baseline; 128 must meet a tighter limit.
Scene tolerances include finite directional resolution and occupied-cell approximation; passing does not imply triangle-equivalent visibility.
Reference uncertainty is checked independently with two deterministic scrambled cosine integrations; failure is inconclusive, not an engine pass.
Umbra is defined analytically by fixture geometry, not by missing Monte Carlo samples. Fullscale is emitter radiance times maximum receiver diffuse reflectance.
Stationary and decay limits are numerical/history checks, independent of the image approximation allowances.
